name: Driver Payroll Report
purpose: Checks September pay for each delivery driver and flags driving licences that are about to expire

inputs.sheet_row_number: Row number copied from the original payroll sheet; it has gaps and is not an employee ID
inputs.name_with_initials: Driver's official name written with initials, e.g. A.B. Perera
inputs.emergency_contact: Phone number to call in an emergency, e.g. a family member
inputs.allowance: Fuel and meal allowance for the month
inputs.overtime_hours: Hours of overtime worked in the month
inputs.overtime_pay: Amount paid for overtime in the month
inputs.gross_pay: Total pay before deductions: basic salary plus allowance plus overtime pay
inputs.join_date: Date the driver joined the company
inputs.licence_expiry: Date the driver's driving licence expires
inputs.vehicle_number: Registration number of the vehicle the driver is assigned
inputs.vehicle_type: Type of vehicle, e.g. van, truck or motorcycle
inputs.employment_type: Type of employment, e.g. permanent or contract
inputs.is_active: Whether the driver is currently working for the company
inputs.net_pay: Take-home pay after tax and other deductions
